notes: חִנָּם is recast as the relative clause which cost me nothing; the supplied relative and verb belong to that adverb's own unit, since the verb is what its lexeme names (rule 46). Head taken on nothing; the competing head is cost, the verb the recasting writes.
וְלֹא fuses to neither, headed on the negative (rule 35); מֵאֵת fuses to of, headed on the opening morpheme (rule 23).
The it of will verily buy it is added: no object morpheme stands in the clause (rule 44).
